headlines.title: 上半年全国社会物流总额超180万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国物流与采购联合会今天（29日）公布今年上半年物流运行数据。上半年，物流需求规模持续扩大，结构优化与动能转换特征突出。今年上半年，全国社会物流总额181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%，高于同期GDP增速0.4个百分点，物流需求对国民经济增长的支撑引领作用持续增强。分季度看，一、二季度分别增长6.2%、4.4%，总体呈现稳中有增的发展态势。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan: Periodic bubbles in the AI development process are normal; China has advantages in four major areas.
headlines.summary_en: JP Morgan's Greater China Chief Economist Zhu Feng: AI industry likely a global trend; market bubbles are normal during AI advancement. Markets price in years of earnings prematurely; corrections are natural if doubts arise on ROI, fundamentals, inference costs, or profit conversion. Future AI competition hinges on cost-efficient, high-quality inference embedded in real business processes. Key variables: computing costs, model efficiency, inference pricing.

headlines.title: 黄仁勋与美国商务部长会面，讨论四年在美生产5000亿美元技术产品
headlines.summary: 7 月 29 日，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋周二与美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克会面。黄仁勋此行旨在与两党领导人会面，讨论英伟达四年内在美国本土生产价值 5000 亿美元技术产品以强化国家供应链的计划，以及美国在 AI 领域的领导地位，包括在开源方面的领先优势。黄仁勋本周在华盛顿的行程还包括与参议院情报委员会首席民主党议员马克·华纳及其他两党国会议员会面。与此同时，特朗普政府正敲定一项新框架，要求最先进的 AI 模型在发布前须向美国政府提供早期访问权限，并正在权衡对开源 AI 的政策立场。

headlines.title_en: Jensen Huang meets with U.S. Commerce Secretary to discuss producing $500 billion in technology products in the U.S. over four years.
headlines.summary_en: July 29: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang met US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick; discussed producing $500 billion in tech products in US over 4 years to strengthen national supply chain. headlines.title: 港股迎来解禁高峰
headlines.summary: 进入2026年下半年，港股市场迎来限售股解禁高峰期。多家机构测算，2026年港股全年解禁规模或接近2万亿港元，较2025年大幅增长，今年7月、9月和12月成为筹码集中释放的重要时点。不过，从历史经验及近期市场表现看，机构普遍认为，解禁不等同于减持，其影响更多集中于部分流通盘较小、解禁比例较高的个股，尚不足以对港股大盘构成系统性冲击。与此同时，南向资金在部分核心标的上仍展现出较强的定向承接力，多家上市公司的基石投资者、战略股东及管理层也主动延长锁定期或作出不减持承诺，凸显长期资金对优质港股资产的认可。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stocks face peak of lock-up expirations
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of 2026, the Hong Kong stock market will face a peak period of lock-up share expirations. Multiple institutions estimate that the total value of shares unlocking in Hong Kong stocks in 2026 could approach HK$2 trillion, a significant increase from 2025. July, September, and December of this year will be key periods for concentrated share release. However, based on historical experience and recent market performance, institutions generally believe that share unlocking does not equate to actual selling. Its impact is mostly concentrated on stocks with small free float and high unlocking ratios, and it is unlikely to pose a systemic shock to the Hong Kong market as a whole. Meanwhile, northbound capital continues to show strong targeted buying support for certain core stocks. Several listed companies' cornerstone investors, strategic shareholders, and management teams have voluntarily extended lock-up periods or pledged not to sell, highlighting long-term capital's recognition of high-quality Hong Kong stock assets. (China Securities Journal)
